##Português

**Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. 
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**.

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: 233.709.318-26

Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: sofiacostaalves1@gmail.com 
Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor.

**Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

##English

**Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**.

Payment with PIX method: 233.709.318-26

Send the payment proof to E-mail: sofiacostaalves1@gmail.com 
Send the proof with the competitor's name.

**Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc0MDAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--640315e33ceb321ec0882ceb40225779eeac3863/LIGA%20SLP%20VERDE%20PNG.png)
# **ESPAÑOL**

Te invitamos a una serie de mini competencias que se llevarán a cabo en San Luis Potosí, totalmente gratuitas. Estas competencias están diseñadas para ofrecer a los participantes una experiencia divertida y relajada, ideal tanto para principiantes como para aquellos que quieran mejorar sus habilidades. ¡No pierdas la oportunidad de unirte y disfrutar de esta emocionante serie de eventos!.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.


# **ENGLISH**

We invite you to a series of mini competitions that will take place in San Luis Potosí, completely free of charge. These competitions are designed to offer participants a fun and relaxed experience, ideal for beginners as well as those who want to improve their skills. Don’t miss the chance to join and enjoy this exciting series of events!
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

items.information:
**ESPAÑOL**
Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PUCPZomblinders2024#48287-registro-register) para obtener información detallada.
•
Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)
•
Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo.
[Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY)
[Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/)
•
Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.
•
**ENGLISH**
See the [Register tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PUCPZomblinders2024#48287-registro-register) for detailed information.
•
Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)
•
We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted.
[WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)
•
It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information:
###	This competition will take place in the Bristol venue of Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024 on the day after. You can register for RUKC FMC 2024 [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024) if you would like to participate in that also. Please note registration for both competitions is separate.

This is a side events specialist events competition, so we do not recommend this competition to first time competitors.

Guests of competitors are welcome to attend for free, however we will not be accepting spectators as this is a small competition with limited space available. 

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.
